library(MVN)

result$univariate_normality

# Question 5: T2 test statistic, degrees of freedom, p-value
# Comparison of two mean vectors (equal Σ’s)

```{r}

# Split the data by river: X = Monongahela, Y = Allegheny
X <- as.matrix(data_df[data_df$river == "M", c("erected", "length")])
Y <- as.matrix(data_df[data_df$river == "A", c("erected", "length")])

n1 <- nrow(X)
n2 <- nrow(Y)
p <- ncol(X)  # for the scaled f-statistic

# Pooled covariance and raw T2
SX <- cov(X)
SY <- cov(Y)
Spooled <- (((n1 - 1) * SX) + ((n2 - 1) * SY)) / (n1 + n2 - 2)
T2 <- t(as.matrix(colMeans(X) - colMeans(Y))) %*% solve(Spooled * (1 / n1 + 1 / n2)) %*%
    (as.matrix(colMeans(X) - colMeans(Y)))  # raw T2

print("Raw T2")
print(T2)
cat("\n")

# Scale T2 to an F statistic and get the p-value
Fstat <- T2 * (n1 + n2 - p - 1) / ((n1 + n2 - 2) * p) # scaled F-statistic
df1 <- p
df2 <- n1 + n2 - p - 1
pval <- pf(Fstat, df1, df2, lower.tail = FALSE)

cat("n1 =", n1, "\n")
cat("n2 =", n2, "\n")
cat("T2 =", round(T2, 4), "\n")
cat("F =", round(Fstat, 4)," on df", df1, "and", df2, "\n")
cat("p-value =", round(pval, 4), "\n")
cat("\n")

# Cross-check with the packages
library(Hotelling)
library(DescTools)

print ("hotelling.test reports raw T2")
print(hotelling.test(x = X, y = Y, var.equal = TRUE))
cat("\n")
print ("HotellingsT2Test reports the scaled Fstat as T.2")
HotellingsT2Test(X, Y)   

```
